note: SHA-256 hashes of the vendored binary assets, verified by npm run check:security (scripts/security-scan.mjs). A hash mismatch, a missing listed file, or a binary file not listed here fails the scan. Recompute with `sha256sum <file>` after any re-import and update this file in the same commit (audit A5-09). Paths are POSIX, relative to the repo root.
